ara::crypto::CustomDisposable
Syntax:
class TrustedContainer :
public CustomDisposable {...};
Header file:
#include "ara/crypto/common/trusted_container.h"
Description:
Formal interface of a Trusted Container is used for saving and loading of security objects.
Notes:
Actual saving and loading should be implemented by internal methods known to a trusted pair
of Crypto Provider and Storage Provider.
Each object should be uniquely identified by its type and Crypto Object Unique Identifier
(COUID).
This interface suppose that objects in the container are compressed i.e. have a minimal size
optimized for saving or transferring.
